fields.title: Formulate SLIs
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each scenario, formulate an indicator and state what is not considered a failure.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Checkout 2. Catalog search 3. Partner webhook delivery 4. Uploading a photo in a review
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — proportion of submits resulting in an order created faster than 3 s; out of stock rejection is not a failure, timeout is a failure. 2 — proportion of responses faster than 800 ms; empty search result is not a failure. 3 — proportion of webhooks delivered within 15 minutes; partner-side rejection is not our failure, but is logged. 4 — proportion of successful uploads; file size rejection is not a failure. Rule of thumb: defining success is more important than the number.
